title: Hearty Venezuelan Oxtail Stew
description: A rich and flavorful stew featuring oxtail, served with a side of crusty bread or over rice, this dish is a showstopper at any gathering, with a yeasty and glassy jelly like texture, it is a must try for any food enthusiast, and can be made plant based friendly by substituting the traditional beef broth with a plant based alternative.
instructions: Heat oil in a large dutch oven over medium high heat.
Add the oxtail pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned oxtail from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, red wine, beef broth, brown sugar, and smoked paprika to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the browned oxtail to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the oxtail is tender.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
